title: 08. Multi-Agent & Patterns: Agentic RAG
summary: Say "implement Agentic RAG with LangGraph" or "build production RAG with Azure AI Search" for specific deep dives!

sections.title: Introduction
sections.body: **Agentic RAG** goes far beyond basic RAG. Instead of a simple **retrieve → generate** pipeline, an **Agentic RAG** system uses an **autonomous agent** that can **decide when to retrieve**, **what to retrieve**, **from where**, **how many times**, and **whether the retrieved context is good enough** — all dynamically.

sections.title: Basic RAG vs Agentic RAG
sections.body:
```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                BASIC RAG vs AGENTIC RAG                         │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

BASIC RAG:
──────────────────────────────────────────────────
  Question → [Embed] → [Vector Search] → [LLM] → Answer
  
  ❌ Always retrieves (even when not needed)
  ❌ Fixed top-K chunks
  ❌ Single retrieval step
  ❌ No quality check on retrieved docs
  ❌ Cannot search multiple sources
  ❌ Cannot reformulate query if results are poor

AGENTIC RAG:
──────────────────────────────────────────────────
  Question
      │
      ▼
  ┌──────────────────────────────────────────┐
  │              RAG AGENT                   │
  │                                          │
  │  🧠 Thinks: "Do I need to retrieve?"    │
  │  🔍 Decides: WHICH source to search     │
  │  📊 Evaluates: Is retrieved context good?│
  │  🔄 Iterates: Refine query if needed    │
  │  ✅ Answers: When satisfied             │
  └──────────────────────────────────────────┘
  
  ✅ Retrieves only when needed
  ✅ Dynamic query reformulation
  ✅ Multi-source retrieval
  ✅ Self-evaluates retrieval quality
  ✅ Iterative retrieval until satisfied
  ✅ Can combine multiple retrievals
```

sections.body:

```
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│               ALL AGENTIC RAG PATTERNS                           │
│                                                                  │
│  1️⃣  Routing RAG          → Route query to right knowledge base  │
│  2️⃣  Query Rewriting RAG  → Rewrite query for better retrieval  │
│  3️⃣  Iterative RAG        → Retrieve → evaluate → re-retrieve   │
│  4️⃣  Corrective RAG       → Check relevance, correct if bad     │
│  5️⃣  Self-RAG             → Decide IF/WHEN to retrieve          │
│  6️⃣  Fusion RAG           → Multi-query → merge results         │
│  7️⃣  Multi-Hop RAG        → Chain retrievals across docs        │
│  8️⃣  Adaptive RAG         → Choose retrieval strategy per query  │
│                                                                  │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

### `vector_store.py` + `embeddings.py` + `indexer.py`

```python name=agentic_rag/embeddings.py
import os
from openai import AzureOpenAI
from dotenv import load_dotenv

load_dotenv()
client = AzureOpenAI(
    azure_endpoint = os.getenv("AZURE_OPENAI_ENDPOINT"),
    api_key        = os.getenv("AZURE_OPENAI_API_KEY"),
    api_version    = os.getenv("AZURE_OPENAI_API_VERSION"),
)
EMBED_MODEL = os.getenv("AZURE_OPENAI_EMBEDDING_DEPLOYMENT", "text-embedding-ada-002")

def get_embedding(text: str) -> list[float]:
    text = text.replace("\n", " ").strip()
    r    = client.embeddings.create(input=text, model=EMBED_MODEL)
    return r.data[0].embedding

def get_embeddings_batch(texts: list[str]) -> list[list[float]]:
    texts = [t.replace("\n", " ").strip() for t in texts]
    r     = client.embeddings.create(input=texts, model=EMBED_MODEL)
    return [item.embedding for item in r.data]
```

```python name=agentic_rag/vector_store.py
import numpy as np
from dataclasses import dataclass, field

@dataclass
class VectorDoc:
    id:        str
    title:     str
    content:   str
    domain:    str
    embedding: list[float] = field(repr=False)

class VectorStore:
    def __init__(self, name: str = "default"):
        self.name      = name
        self.documents: list[VectorDoc] = []

    def add(self, doc: VectorDoc):
        self.documents.append(doc)

    def search(self, query_embedding: list[float],
               top_k: int = 3,
               threshold: float = 0.0) -> list[tuple["VectorDoc", float]]:
        if not self.documents:
            return []
        qv = np.array(query_embedding, dtype=np.float32)
        qv = qv / (np.linalg.norm(qv) + 1e-10)
        scored = []
        for doc in self.documents:
            dv    = np.array(doc.embedding, dtype=np.float32)
            dv    = dv / (np.linalg.norm(dv) + 1e-10)
            score = float(np.dot(qv, dv))
            if score >= threshold:
                scored.append((doc, score))
        scored.sort(key=lambda x: x[1], reverse=True)
        return scored[:top_k]

    def __len__(self): return len(self.documents)
```

```python name=agentic_rag/indexer.py
from documents    import DOMAIN_DOCS, ALL_DOCS
from embeddings   import get_embeddings_batch
from vector_store import VectorStore, VectorDoc

def build_domain_stores() -> dict[str, VectorStore]:
    """Build one VectorStore per domain."""
    print("🔨 Building domain-specific vector stores...\n")
    stores = {}
    for domain, docs in DOMAIN_DOCS.items():
        store  = VectorStore(name=domain)
        texts  = [d["content"] for d in docs]
        embeds = get_embeddings_batch(texts)
        for doc, emb in zip(docs, embeds):
            store.add(VectorDoc(
                id=doc["id"], title=doc["title"],
                content=doc["content"], domain=domain, embedding=emb
            ))
        stores[domain] = store
        print(f"  ✅ [{domain}] store: {len(store)} docs indexed")
    return stores

def build_global_store() -> VectorStore:
    """Build one global VectorStore with all docs."""
    store  = VectorStore(name="global")
    texts  = [d["content"] for d in ALL_DOCS]
    embeds = get_embeddings_batch(texts)
    for doc, emb in zip(ALL_DOCS, embeds):
        domain = doc["id"].split("_")[0]
        store.add(VectorDoc(
            id=doc["id"], title=doc["title"],
            content=doc["content"], domain=domain, embedding=emb
        ))
    print(f"\n  ✅ Global store: {len(store)} docs indexed\n")
    return store
```

sections.title: Pattern 1 — Routing RAG
sections.body:
```python name=agentic_rag/patterns/01_routing_rag.py
"""
ROUTING RAG: Agent decides WHICH knowledge base to query
based on the nature of the question.

User Q → Router → [AI KB | Tech KB | Science KB] → Answer
"""
import os
from openai       import AzureOpenAI
from dotenv       import load_dotenv
from embeddings   import get_embedding
from vector_store import VectorStore

load_dotenv()
client     = AzureOpenAI(
    azure_endpoint=os.getenv("AZURE_OPENAI_ENDPOINT"),
    api_key=os.getenv("AZURE_OPENAI_API_KEY"),
    api_version=os.getenv("AZURE_OPENAI_API_VERSION"),
)
DEPLOYMENT = os.getenv("AZURE_OPENAI_DEPLOYMENT")

def llm(system: str, user: str, temp: float = 0.0) -> str:
    r = client.chat.completions.create(
        model=DEPLOYMENT,
        messages=[{"role":"system","content":system},
                  {"role":"user","content":user}],
        temperature=temp, max_tokens=600,
    )
    return r.choices[0].message.content.strip()

def route_query(query: str) -> list[str]:
    """Decides which domain(s) to search."""
    result = llm(
        system="""Classify the query into one or more domains.
Return ONLY a comma-separated list from: ai, tech, science
Example: 'ai' or 'ai,tech' or 'science'""",
        user=query
    )
    domains = [d.strip().lower() for d in result.split(",")]
    valid   = [d for d in domains if d in ["ai","tech","science"]]
    return valid if valid else ["ai"]

def routing_rag(query: str, stores: dict[str, VectorStore]) -> str:
    print(f"\n{'='*55}")
    print(f"🗺️  ROUTING RAG")
    print(f"❓ Query: {query}")

    # Step 1: Route
    domains = route_query(query)
    print(f"📍 Routed to domains: {domains}")

    # Step 2: Retrieve from routed domains
    qembed  = get_embedding(query)
    context = ""
    for domain in domains:
        store   = stores.get(domain)
        if not store: continue
        results = store.search(qembed, top_k=2)
        for doc, score in results:
            context += f"[{domain.upper()} | {doc.title} | score:{score:.3f}]\n"
            context += f"{doc.content}\n\n"
            print(f"   📄 [{score:.3f}] {doc.title}")

    # Step 3: Generate
    answer = llm(
        system="Answer using ONLY the provided context. Cite sources.",
        user  =f"Context:\n{context}\n\nQuestion: {query}"
    )
    print(f"\n✅ Answer:\n{answer}")
    return answer
```

sections.title: Pattern 2 — Query Rewriting RAG
sections.body:
```python name=agentic_rag/patterns/02_query_rewriting_rag.py
"""
QUERY REWRITING RAG: If initial retrieval is poor,
the agent rewrites the query to improve results.

Query → Retrieve → [Quality Check] → Rewrite → Re-retrieve → Answer
"""
import os
from openai       import AzureOpenAI
from dotenv       import load_dotenv
from embeddings   import get_embedding
from vector_store import VectorStore

load_dotenv()
client     = AzureOpenAI(
    azure_endpoint=os.getenv("AZURE_OPENAI_ENDPOINT"),
    api_key=os.getenv("AZURE_OPENAI_API_KEY"),
    api_version=os.getenv("AZURE_OPENAI_API_VERSION"),
)
DEPLOYMENT = os.getenv("AZURE_OPENAI_DEPLOYMENT")

def llm(system: str, user: str, temp: float = 0.0) -> str:
    r = client.chat.completions.create(
        model=DEPLOYMENT,
        messages=[{"role":"system","content":system},
                  {"role":"user","content":user}],
        temperature=temp, max_tokens=600,
    )
    return r.choices[0].message.content.strip()

def rewrite_query(original: str, attempt: int) -> str:
    """Rewrites query to be more specific and searchable."""
    return llm(
        system="""You are a query optimization expert.
Rewrite the query to be more specific and likely to retrieve
relevant documents from a vector database.
Return ONLY the rewritten query, nothing else.""",
        user=f"Original query (attempt {attempt}): {original}",
        temp=0.4,
    )

def score_retrieval(query: str, docs: list) -> float:
    """Scores how relevant the retrieved docs are (0-1)."""
    if not docs: return 0.0
    context = "\n".join([f"- {d[0].title}: {d[0].content[:100]}" for d in docs])
    result  = llm(
        system="Rate relevance of these docs to the query. Reply with ONLY a float 0.0-1.0",
        user  =f"Query: {query}\nDocs:\n{context}",
    )
    try:    return min(max(float(result.strip()), 0.0), 1.0)
    except: return 0.5

def query_rewriting_rag(query: str, store: VectorStore,
                         max_rewrites: int = 3,
                         quality_threshold: float = 0.7) -> str:
    print(f"\n{'='*55}")
    print(f"✏️  QUERY REWRITING RAG")
    print(f"❓ Original Query: {query}")

    current_query = query

    for attempt in range(1, max_rewrites + 1):
        print(f"\n  🔄 Attempt {attempt}: '{current_query}'")

        # Retrieve
        qembed  = get_embedding(current_query)
        results = store.search(qembed, top_k=3)

        # Evaluate quality
        quality = score_retrieval(current_query, results)
        print(f"  📊 Retrieval quality: {quality:.2f}")

        if quality >= quality_threshold:
            print(f"  ✅ Quality threshold met!")
            break

        if attempt < max_rewrites:
            current_query = rewrite_query(query, attempt)
            print(f"  🔁 Rewritten to: '{current_query}'")

    # Build context
    context = ""
    for doc, score in results:
        context += f"[{doc.title} | relevance:{score:.3f}]\n{doc.content}\n\n"

    answer = llm(
        system="Answer using ONLY the provided context.",
        user  =f"Context:\n{context}\n\nQuestion: {query}",
    )
    print(f"\n✅ Answer:\n{answer}")
    return answer
```

sections.title: Pattern 3 — Iterative RAG
sections.body:
```python name=agentic_rag/patterns/03_iterative_rag.py
"""
ITERATIVE RAG: Agent iteratively retrieves and refines
until it has enough context to answer confidently.

Q → Retrieve → [Enough context?] → NO → Refine → Re-retrieve
                      │
                      YES → Generate Answer
"""
import os
from openai       import AzureOpenAI
from dotenv       import load_dotenv
from embeddings   import get_embedding
from vector_store import VectorStore

load_dotenv()
client     = AzureOpenAI(
    azure_endpoint=os.getenv("AZURE_OPENAI_ENDPOINT"),
    api_key=os.getenv("AZURE_OPENAI_API_KEY"),
    api_version=os.getenv("AZURE_OPENAI_API_VERSION"),
)
DEPLOYMENT = os.getenv("AZURE_OPENAI_DEPLOYMENT")

def llm(system: str, user: str, temp: float = 0.0) -> str:
    r = client.chat.completions.create(
        model=DEPLOYMENT,
        messages=[{"role":"system","content":system},
                  {"role":"user","content":user}],
        temperature=temp, max_tokens=600,
    )
    return r.choices[0].message.content.strip()

def is_context_sufficient(question: str, context: str) -> tuple[bool, str]:
    """Checks if current context is enough to answer the question."""
    result = llm(
        system="""Evaluate if the context is sufficient to answer the question.
Reply in this format:
SUFFICIENT: YES or NO
MISSING: what information is still needed (if NO)
FOLLOWUP: a specific follow-up search query to get missing info (if NO)""",
        user=f"Question: {question}\n\nContext so far:\n{context}"
    )
    sufficient = "SUFFICIENT: YES" in result.upper()
    # Extract follow-up query
    followup   = ""
    for line in result.split("\n"):
        if line.upper().startswith("FOLLOWUP:"):
            followup = line.split(":", 1)[1].strip()
    return sufficient, followup

def iterative_rag(question: str, store: VectorStore,
                   max_iterations: int = 4) -> str:
    print(f"\n{'='*55}")
    print(f"🔄 ITERATIVE RAG")
    print(f"❓ Question: {question}")

    all_context = ""
    current_q   = question
    all_docs    = set()

    for iteration in range(1, max_iterations + 1):
        print(f"\n  🔁 Iteration {iteration}: '{current_q}'")

        # Retrieve
        qembed  = get_embedding(current_q)
        results = store.search(qembed, top_k=2)

        # Add new docs to context
        new_added = 0
        for doc, score in results:
            if doc.id not in all_docs:
                all_context += f"[{doc.title} | score:{score:.3f}]\n{doc.content}\n\n"
                all_docs.add(doc.id)
                new_added += 1
                print(f"     📄 Added: {doc.title} ({score:.3f})")

        if new_added == 0:
            print(f"     ⚠️  No new docs found. Stopping.")
            break

        # Check if sufficient
        sufficient, followup = is_context_sufficient(question, all_context)
        print(f"     📊 Sufficient: {sufficient}")

        if sufficient:
            print(f"     ✅ Context is sufficient!")
            break

        if followup:
            current_q = followup
            print(f"     🔍 Follow-up query: '{followup}'")

    # Generate final answer
    answer = llm(
        system="""Answer the question using ONLY the provided context.
Be comprehensive and cite which sources support each point.""",
        user=f"Context:\n{all_context}\n\nQuestion: {question}",
        temp=0.1,
    )
    print(f"\n✅ Final Answer:\n{answer}")
    return answer
```

sections.title: Pattern 4 — Corrective RAG (CRAG)
sections.body:
```python name=agentic_rag/patterns/04_corrective_rag.py
"""
CORRECTIVE RAG (CRAG):
Retrieves → Grades each doc → Filters irrelevant ones →
If too many filtered → Web search fallback → Generate

GRADE: RELEVANT / IRRELEVANT / AMBIGUOUS
"""
import os
from openai       import AzureOpenAI
from dotenv       import load_dotenv
from embeddings   import get_embedding
from vector_store import VectorStore, VectorDoc

load_dotenv()
client     = AzureOpenAI(
    azure_endpoint=os.getenv("AZURE_OPENAI_ENDPOINT"),
    api_key=os.getenv("AZURE_OPENAI_API_KEY"),
    api_version=os.getenv("AZURE_OPENAI_API_VERSION"),
)
DEPLOYMENT = os.getenv("AZURE_OPENAI_DEPLOYMENT")

def llm(system: str, user: str, temp: float = 0.0) -> str:
    r = client.chat.completions.create(
        model=DEPLOYMENT,
        messages=[{"role":"system","content":system},
                  {"role":"user","content":user}],
        temperature=temp, max_tokens=600,
    )
    return r.choices[0].message.content.strip()

def grade_document(question: str, doc_content: str) -> str:
    """Grades a document as RELEVANT, IRRELEVANT, or AMBIGUOUS."""
    result = llm(
        system="""Grade the relevance of the document to the question.
Reply with ONLY one word: RELEVANT, IRRELEVANT, or AMBIGUOUS""",
        user=f"Question: {question}\n\nDocument: {doc_content[:500]}"
    )
    grade = result.strip().upper()
    return grade if grade in ["RELEVANT","IRRELEVANT","AMBIGUOUS"] else "AMBIGUOUS"

def web_search_fallback(query: str) -> str:
    """Simulated web search when vector DB is insufficient."""
    knowledge = {
        "rag":         "RAG combines retrieval with generation for grounded answers.",
        "agent":       "AI agents are autonomous systems that reason and act.",
        "azure":       "Azure OpenAI provides enterprise-grade LLM access.",
        "python":      "Python is the most popular AI/ML programming language.",
        "quantum":     "Quantum computing uses qubits for exponential speedup.",
        "langchain":   "LangChain is a framework for building LLM applications.",
        "langgraph":   "LangGraph enables stateful multi-agent graph workflows.",
    }
    for key, val in knowledge.items():
        if key in query.lower():
            return f"[Web Search Result]: {val}"
    return f"[Web Search Result]: General information about '{query}'"

def corrective_rag(question: str, store: VectorStore) -> str:
    print(f"\n{'='*55}")
    print(f"🔧 CORRECTIVE RAG (CRAG)")
    print(f"❓ Question: {question}")

    # Step 1: Initial retrieval
    qembed  = get_embedding(question)
    results = store.search(qembed, top_k=4)

    # Step 2: Grade each document
    print(f"\n  📊 Grading {len(results)} retrieved documents:")
    relevant   = []
    irrelevant = []

    for doc, score in results:
        grade = grade_document(question, doc.content)
        print(f"     [{grade:11s}] {doc.title} ({score:.3f})")
        if grade == "RELEVANT":
            relevant.append((doc, score))
        elif grade == "IRRELEVANT":
            irrelevant.append((doc, score))
        else:  # AMBIGUOUS
            relevant.append((doc, score))  # Keep ambiguous

    # Step 3: Correct if too few relevant docs
    context    = ""
    used_web   = False

    if len(relevant) >= 2:
        print(f"\n  ✅ Sufficient relevant docs ({len(relevant)})")
        for doc, score in relevant:
            context += f"[{doc.title}]\n{doc.content}\n\n"
    else:
        print(f"\n  ⚠️  Insufficient relevant docs ({len(relevant)}). Using web fallback...")
        web_result = web_search_fallback(question)
        context    = web_result + "\n\n"
        for doc, score in relevant:
            context += f"[{doc.title}]\n{doc.content}\n\n"
        used_web = True
        print(f"     🌐 Web fallback added")

    # Step 4: Generate corrected answer
    source_note = "Sources: Vector DB + Web Search" if used_web else "Sources: Vector DB"
    answer = llm(
        system=f"Answer using ONLY the provided context. {source_note}",
        user  =f"Context:\n{context}\n\nQuestion: {question}",
        temp  =0.1,
    )
    print(f"\n✅ Corrected Answer:\n{answer}")
    return answer
```

sections.title: Pattern 5 — Self-RAG
sections.body:
```python name=agentic_rag/patterns/05_self_rag.py
"""
SELF-RAG: Agent dynamically decides:
1. WHETHER to retrieve at all
2. Whether retrieved docs are RELEVANT
3. Whether generated answer is GROUNDED
4. Whether answer is USEFUL

Retrieval tokens: [Retrieve], [No Retrieve]
Critique tokens:  [Relevant], [Irrelevant], [Grounded], [Not Grounded]
"""
import os
from openai       import AzureOpenAI
from dotenv       import load_dotenv
from embeddings   import get_embedding
from vector_store import VectorStore

load_dotenv()
client     = AzureOpenAI(
    azure_endpoint=os.getenv("AZURE_OPENAI_ENDPOINT"),
    api_key=os.getenv("AZURE_OPENAI_API_KEY"),
    api_version=os.getenv("AZURE_OPENAI_API_VERSION"),
)
DEPLOYMENT = os.getenv("AZURE_OPENAI_DEPLOYMENT")

def llm(system: str, user: str, temp: float = 0.0) -> str:
    r = client.chat.completions.create(
        model=DEPLOYMENT,
        messages=[{"role":"system","content":system},
                  {"role":"user","content":user}],
        temperature=temp, max_tokens=600,
    )
    return r.choices[0].message.content.strip()

def should_retrieve(question: str) -> bool:
    """Decides if retrieval is needed for this question."""
    result = llm(
        system="""Decide if external knowledge retrieval is needed.
Reply with ONLY: RETRIEVE or NO_RETRIEVE
RETRIEVE: factual questions, recent info, domain-specific knowledge
NO_RETRIEVE: simple math, general reasoning, opinions""",
        user=question
    )
    return "RETRIEVE" in result.upper()

def is_relevant(question: str, doc_content: str) -> bool:
    r = llm(
        system="Is this document relevant to the question? Reply ONLY: YES or NO",
        user  =f"Q: {question}\nDoc: {doc_content[:400]}"
    )
    return "YES" in r.upper()

def is_grounded(answer: str, context: str) -> bool:
    r = llm(
        system="Is this answer fully grounded in the context? Reply ONLY: YES or NO",
        user  =f"Context: {context[:600]}\nAnswer: {answer}"
    )
    return "YES" in r.upper()

def self_rag(question: str, store: VectorStore) -> str:
    print(f"\n{'='*55}")
    print(f"🧠 SELF-RAG")
    print(f"❓ Question: {question}")

    # Step 1: Decide whether to retrieve
    retrieve = should_retrieve(question)
    print(f"\n  🤔 Should retrieve? → {'YES' if retrieve else 'NO'}")

    if not retrieve:
        # Answer from parametric knowledge
        answer = llm(
            system="Answer from your knowledge. Be concise and accurate.",
            user  =question, temp=0.3,
        )
        print(f"\n  ✅ Answer (no retrieval):\n{answer}")
        return answer

    # Step 2: Retrieve and filter
    qembed   = get_embedding(question)
    results  = store.search(qembed, top_k=4)
    relevant = []
    print(f"\n  📄 Filtering {len(results)} retrieved docs:")

    for doc, score in results:
        rel = is_relevant(question, doc.content)
        tag = "✅ RELEVANT" if rel else "❌ FILTERED"
        print(f"     {tag}: {doc.title} ({score:.3f})")
        if rel:
            relevant.append(doc)

    if not relevant:
        print(f"  ⚠️  No relevant docs. Answering from knowledge.")
        answer = llm("Answer from your knowledge.", question, temp=0.3)
        print(f"\n  ✅ Answer:\n{answer}")
        return answer

    # Step 3: Generate grounded answer
    context = "\n\n".join([f"[{d.title}]\n{d.content}" for d in relevant])
    answer  = llm(
        system="Answer ONLY from the provided context. Be precise.",
        user  =f"Context:\n{context}\n\nQuestion: {question}", temp=0.1,
    )

    # Step 4: Check if answer is grounded
    grounded = is_grounded(answer, context)
    print(f"\n  📊 Answer grounded? → {'YES ✅' if grounded else 'NO ⚠️'}")

    if not grounded:
        # Regenerate more carefully
        answer = llm(
            system="Answer STRICTLY using only facts from the context. No assumptions.",
            user  =f"Context:\n{context}\n\nQuestion: {question}", temp=0.0,
        )
        print(f"  🔁 Regenerated grounded answer")

    print(f"\n✅ Final Answer:\n{answer}")
    return answer
```

sections.title: Pattern 6 — Fusion RAG
sections.body:
```python name=agentic_rag/patterns/06_fusion_rag.py
"""
FUSION RAG: Generate MULTIPLE search queries from one question,
retrieve for each, deduplicate + rank results using
Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF), then generate answer.

Question → [Q1, Q2, Q3] → Retrieve each → RRF → Top docs → Answer
"""
import os
from openai       import AzureOpenAI
from dotenv       import load_dotenv
from embeddings   import get_embedding, get_embeddings_batch
from vector_store import VectorStore, VectorDoc

load_dotenv()
client     = AzureOpenAI(
    azure_endpoint=os.getenv("AZURE_OPENAI_ENDPOINT"),
    api_key=os.getenv("AZURE_OPENAI_API_KEY"),
    api_version=os.getenv("AZURE_OPENAI_API_VERSION"),
)
DEPLOYMENT = os.getenv("AZURE_OPENAI_DEPLOYMENT")

def llm(system: str, user: str, temp: float = 0.0) -> str:
    r = client.chat.completions.create(
        model=DEPLOYMENT,
        messages=[{"role":"system","content":system},
                  {"role":"user","content":user}],
        temperature=temp, max_tokens=600,
    )
    return r.choices[0].message.content.strip()

def generate_queries(question: str, n: int = 4) -> list[str]:
    """Generates N diverse search queries from one question."""
    result = llm(
        system=f"""Generate {n} diverse search queries to retrieve information
for answering the question. Each query should target a different aspect.
Return ONLY the queries, one per line, no numbering.""",
        user=question, temp=0.6,
    )
    queries = [q.strip() for q in result.split("\n") if q.strip()]
    return queries[:n]

def reciprocal_rank_fusion(all_results: list[list[tuple]],
                            k: int = 60) -> list[tuple[VectorDoc, float]]:
    """
    RRF score = sum(1 / (k + rank)) across all result lists.
    Combines rankings from multiple searches.
    """
    rrf_scores: dict[str, float]   = {}
    doc_map:    dict[str, VectorDoc] = {}

    for results in all_results:
        for rank, (doc, _) in enumerate(results, start=1):
            if doc.id not in rrf_scores:
                rrf_scores[doc.id] = 0.0
                doc_map[doc.id]    = doc
            rrf_scores[doc.id] += 1.0 / (k + rank)

    # Sort by RRF score
    ranked = sorted(rrf_scores.items(), key=lambda x: x[1], reverse=True)
    return [(doc_map[doc_id], score) for doc_id, score in ranked]

def fusion_rag(question: str, store: VectorStore, n_queries: int = 4) -> str:
    print(f"\n{'='*55}")
    print(f"🔀 FUSION RAG")
    print(f"❓ Question: {question}")

    # Step 1: Generate multiple queries
    queries = generate_queries(question, n_queries)
    print(f"\n  📝 Generated {len(queries)} search queries:")
    for i, q in enumerate(queries, 1):
        print(f"     {i}. {q}")

    # Step 2: Retrieve for each query
    all_results = []
    for q in queries:
        qembed  = get_embedding(q)
        results = store.search(qembed, top_k=3)
        all_results.append(results)

    # Step 3: Reciprocal Rank Fusion
    fused = reciprocal_rank_fusion(all_results)
    print(f"\n  🔀 After RRF fusion ({len(fused)} unique docs):")
    for doc, rrf_score in fused[:4]:
        print(f"     [RRF:{rrf_score:.4f}] {doc.title}")

    # Step 4: Build context from top fused results
    context = ""
    for doc, rrf_score in fused[:3]:
        context += f"[{doc.title} | RRF:{rrf_score:.4f}]\n{doc.content}\n\n"

    # Step 5: Generate answer
    answer = llm(
        system="Answer comprehensively using ONLY the provided context.",
        user  =f"Context:\n{context}\n\nQuestion: {question}", temp=0.1,
    )
    print(f"\n✅ Fusion Answer:\n{answer}")
    return answer
```

sections.title: Pattern 7 — Multi-Hop RAG
sections.body:
```python name=agentic_rag/patterns/07_multihop_rag.py
"""
MULTI-HOP RAG: Chains multiple retrievals to answer
questions requiring information from several documents.

Q: "How does the Agentic RAG pattern improve on basic RAG
    in the context of Azure OpenAI deployments?"

Hop 1: Retrieve about "basic RAG"         → finds limitations
Hop 2: Retrieve about "Agentic RAG"       → finds improvements
Hop 3: Retrieve about "Azure OpenAI RAG"  → finds deployment context
       → Synthesize all hops → Final Answer
"""
import os
from openai       import AzureOpenAI
from dotenv       import load_dotenv
from embeddings   import get_embedding
from vector_store import VectorStore

load_dotenv()
client     = AzureOpenAI(
    azure_endpoint=os.getenv("AZURE_OPENAI_ENDPOINT"),
    api_key=os.getenv("AZURE_OPENAI_API_KEY"),
    api_version=os.getenv("AZURE_OPENAI_API_VERSION"),
)
DEPLOYMENT = os.getenv("AZURE_OPENAI_DEPLOYMENT")

def llm(system: str, user: str, temp: float = 0.0) -> str:
    r = client.chat.completions.create(
        model=DEPLOYMENT,
        messages=[{"role":"system","content":system},
                  {"role":"user","content":user}],
        temperature=temp, max_tokens=600,
    )
    return r.choices[0].message.content.strip()

def decompose_question(question: str) -> list[str]:
    """Breaks complex question into sequential sub-questions."""
    result = llm(
        system="""Break this complex question into 2-3 sequential sub-questions.
Each sub-question should be searchable independently.
Return ONLY sub-questions, one per line.""",
        user=question, temp=0.3,
    )
    return [q.strip() for q in result.split("\n") if q.strip()][:3]

def generate_next_hop(question: str, prev_context: str) -> str:
    """Generates the next search query based on what we know so far."""
    return llm(
        system="""Based on the original question and what we've found so far,
generate the NEXT specific search query to fill knowledge gaps.
Return ONLY the search query.""",
        user=f"Original: {question}\n\nFound so far:\n{prev_context}\n\nNext search:",
        temp=0.3,
    )

def multihop_rag(question: str, store: VectorStore, max_hops: int = 3) -> str:
    print(f"\n{'='*55}")
    print(f"🔗 MULTI-HOP RAG")
    print(f"❓ Question: {question}")

    # Decompose into sub-questions
    sub_questions = decompose_question(question)
    print(f"\n  📋 Sub-questions:")
    for i, sq in enumerate(sub_questions, 1):
        print(f"     {i}. {sq}")

    # Multi-hop retrieval
    all_context  = ""
    seen_doc_ids = set()

    for hop, sub_q in enumerate(sub_questions[:max_hops], 1):
        print(f"\n  🔁 Hop {hop}: '{sub_q}'")

        qembed  = get_embedding(sub_q)
        results = store.search(qembed, top_k=2)

        hop_context = ""
        for doc, score in results:
            if doc.id not in seen_doc_ids:
                hop_context  += f"[{doc.title} | {score:.3f}]\n{doc.content}\n\n"
                seen_doc_ids.add(doc.id)
                print(f"     📄 Retrieved: {doc.title} ({score:.3f})")

        all_context += f"--- Hop {hop} ({sub_q}) ---\n{hop_context}\n"

    # Synthesize across all hops
    answer = llm(
        system="""Answer the complex question by synthesizing information
from ALL the retrieved hops. Connect the information across hops.""",
        user=f"Multi-hop Context:\n{all_context}\n\nOriginal Question: {question}",
        temp=0.1,
    )
    print(f"\n✅ Multi-hop Answer:\n{answer}")
    return answer
```

sections.title: Pattern 8 — Adaptive RAG
sections.body:
```python name=agentic_rag/patterns/08_adaptive_rag.py
"""
ADAPTIVE RAG: Dynamically chooses the BEST retrieval strategy
based on the query complexity and type.

Query Analysis → Choose Strategy:
  SIMPLE    → Direct retrieval (basic RAG)
  COMPLEX   → Multi-hop retrieval
  AMBIGUOUS → Query rewriting first
  BROAD     → Fusion RAG (multiple queries)
  FACTUAL   → Self-RAG (may not need retrieval)
"""
import os
from openai       import AzureOpenAI
from dotenv       import load_dotenv
from vector_store import VectorStore
from embeddings   import get_embedding

load_dotenv()
client     = AzureOpenAI(
    azure_endpoint=os.getenv("AZURE_OPENAI_ENDPOINT"),
    api_key=os.getenv("AZURE_OPENAI_API_KEY"),
    api_version=os.getenv("AZURE_OPENAI_API_VERSION"),
)
DEPLOYMENT = os.getenv("AZURE_OPENAI_DEPLOYMENT")

def llm(system: str, user: str, temp: float = 0.0) -> str:
    r = client.chat.completions.create(
        model=DEPLOYMENT,
        messages=[{"role":"system","content":system},
                  {"role":"user","content":user}],
        temperature=temp, max_tokens=800,
    )
    return r.choices[0].message.content.strip()

def analyze_query(question: str) -> dict:
    """Analyzes query to determine best retrieval strategy."""
    result = llm(
        system="""Analyze this query and return a JSON with:
{
  "complexity": "simple|complex|ambiguous",
  "type": "factual|analytical|comparative|procedural",
  "strategy": "direct|multihop|rewrite|fusion|no_retrieval",
  "reasoning": "why you chose this strategy"
}
Return ONLY valid JSON.""",
        user=question, temp=0.0,
    )
    import json, re
    try:
        match = re.search(r'\{.*\}', result, re.DOTALL)
        return json.loads(match.group()) if match else {
            "complexity":"simple","type":"factual",
            "strategy":"direct","reasoning":"fallback"
        }
    except:
        return {"complexity":"simple","type":"factual",
                "strategy":"direct","reasoning":"parse error"}

def direct_retrieval(q: str, store: VectorStore, top_k: int = 3) -> str:
    emb     = get_embedding(q)
    results = store.search(emb, top_k=top_k)
    return "\n\n".join([f"[{d.title}]\n{d.content}" for d, _ in results])

def adaptive_rag(question: str, store: VectorStore) -> str:
    print(f"\n{'='*55}")
    print(f"🎯 ADAPTIVE RAG")
    print(f"❓ Question: {question}")

    # Analyze query
    analysis = analyze_query(question)
    strategy  = analysis.get("strategy", "direct")
    print(f"\n  📊 Query Analysis:")
    print(f"     Complexity: {analysis.get('complexity')}")
    print(f"     Type:       {analysis.get('type')}")
    print(f"     Strategy:   {strategy}")
    print(f"     Reasoning:  {analysis.get('reasoning')}")

    # Execute chosen strategy
    context = ""

    if strategy == "no_retrieval":
        print(f"\n  ⚡ No retrieval needed — answering from knowledge")
        answer = llm("Answer from your knowledge.", question, temp=0.3)

    elif strategy == "multihop":
        print(f"\n  🔗 Using Multi-Hop strategy")
        # Decompose and retrieve iteratively
        sub_qs = [question, f"background on {question}", f"details about {question}"]
        seen   = set()
        for sq in sub_qs[:2]:
            results = store.search(get_embedding(sq), top_k=2)
            for doc, score in results:
                if doc.id not in seen:
                    context += f"[{doc.title}]\n{doc.content}\n\n"
                    seen.add(doc.id)
                    print(f"     📄 {doc.title} ({score:.3f})")
        answer = llm(
            "Synthesize a comprehensive answer from context.",
            f"Context:\n{context}\n\nQuestion: {question}", temp=0.1,
        )

    elif strategy == "fusion":
        print(f"\n  🔀 Using Fusion strategy")
        # Generate 3 query variants
        variants = llm(
            "Generate 3 different search queries, one per line. No numbering.",
            question, temp=0.5,
        ).split("\n")[:3]
        seen = set()
        for variant in variants:
            results = store.search(get_embedding(variant.strip()), top_k=2)
            for doc, score in results:
                if doc.id not in seen:
                    context += f"[{doc.title}]\n{doc.content}\n\n"
                    seen.add(doc.id)
                    print(f"     📄 {doc.title}")
        answer = llm(
            "Answer comprehensively from context.",
            f"Context:\n{context}\n\nQuestion: {question}", temp=0.1,
        )

    elif strategy == "rewrite":
        print(f"\n  ✏️  Using Query Rewrite strategy")
        rewritten = llm(
            "Rewrite this query to be clearer and more specific. Return ONLY the rewritten query.",
            question, temp=0.3,
        )
        print(f"     Rewritten: '{rewritten}'")
        context = direct_retrieval(rewritten, store)
        answer  = llm(
            "Answer from context.",
            f"Context:\n{context}\n\nQuestion: {question}", temp=0.1,
        )

    else:  # direct
        print(f"\n  📄 Using Direct Retrieval strategy")
        context = direct_retrieval(question, store)
        answer  = llm(
            "Answer using ONLY the provided context.",
            f"Context:\n{context}\n\nQuestion: {question}", temp=0.1,
        )

    print(f"\n✅ Adaptive Answer:\n{answer}")
    return answer
```

```python name=agentic_rag/main.py
from indexer   import build_domain_stores, build_global_store
from patterns.routing_rag        import routing_rag
from patterns.query_rewriting_rag import query_rewriting_rag
```

sections.title: Pattern Comparison
sections.body:
```
┌─────────────────┬──────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ Pattern         │ Best Used When                                   │
├─────────────────┼──────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ Routing RAG     │ Multiple knowledge domains exist                 │
│ Query Rewriting │ Queries are vague or poorly formed               │
│ Iterative RAG   │ Single retrieval may be insufficient             │
│ Corrective RAG  │ Retrieved docs may be noisy/irrelevant           │
│ Self-RAG        │ Not all questions need retrieval                 │
│ Fusion RAG      │ Query has multiple facets to cover               │
│ Multi-Hop RAG   │ Answer requires chaining multiple docs           │
│ Adaptive RAG    │ Query types vary widely (best all-rounder)       │
└─────────────────┴──────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

sections.title: Agentic RAG Decision Tree
sections.body:
```
                    User Question
                         │
              ┌──────────┴──────────┐
              ▼                     ▼
      Needs retrieval?         Simple fact?
           │                        │
          YES                  NO RETRIEVAL
           │
    ┌──────┴──────────────────────┐
    ▼           ▼                 ▼
 Single      Multi-topic?     Ambiguous?
 domain?         │                │
    │          FUSION           REWRITE
    │
    ▼
 Complex      → MULTI-HOP
 Simple       → DIRECT
 Noisy data   → CORRECTIVE
 Varies       → ADAPTIVE
```
